name: fritz_call_action
description: Calls an action that only reads. Secrets in the output are hidden.

name: fritz_calls
description: Latest calls: kind, date, minutes, number, name, own number, device. Filters by kind, days and name or number. Personal data.

days.description: Only calls of the last this many days.

kind.description:
Only calls of these kinds, separated by commas: `incoming`,
`missed`, `outgoing`, `rejected`, `active` or `all`.

limit.description:
Calls to return after the filters, the latest first, at most 200.
Default 50.

search.description: Part of the name, or digits of the number.

name: fritz_capabilities
description: Features the device offers, the rights of the user, two-factor confirmation.

name: fritz_describe_action
description: The class and the arguments of an action, with their types.

name: fritz_diagnose
description: Diagnoses a host end to end: known to the device, active, address, link with mesh node and signal, whether its name resolves to that address, and whether TCP ports are open, closed or filtered. Each check passes, fails with a hint, or is skipped. `router` checks the device: private address, TR-064 over HTTPS and HTTP, web interface, certificate.

host.description:
A host the device knows, by name, MAC or IPv4 address, or `router`
for the device itself.

ports.description:
TCP ports to probe on the host, at most 8. Only on private
addresses, not with `router`.

name: fritz_dns
description: Why a name does or does not resolve: local domain, DNS servers handed out and host table of the router, answers of the router's DNS server and of this machine's resolver, this machine's resolvers and search domains, and a verdict with the likely cause. Asks only for this name; changes nothing.

expected_ip.description: The address the answers should have.

router_dns.description:
The DNS server asked as the router, like `192.168.178.1`. Default:
the LAN address of the device.

name: fritz_doctor
description: Checks the setup step by step: configuration, host, port, certificate, password source, login, rights, two-factor, web interface, Smart Home. Each check: status (ok, warn, fail, skip), detail and hint. Call first when other tools fail.

name: fritz_exposure
description: What can be reached from the internet or managed from outside: remote access, MyFRITZ, dynamic DNS, port forwardings, exposed host, UPnP, FTP, shared links, VPN, TR-069, USP. Each item has a state (on, off, unknown), a count for lists, a severity (info, notice, warning) and hints. Addresses, domains, names and hosts hidden without `--personal`. Link URLs and passwords are never read.

name: fritz_firmware
description: Firmware: state (available, none, unknown, unsupported), installed and offered version, info URL, auto update, last update. Does not check for updates.

name: fritz_hosts
description: Hosts the device knows, with IP, MAC, interface and internet access. Paginated. With mac or ip, the one host with all details: address source, lease, guest network and the mesh node it is connected to.

active.description: Only hosts that are connected now.

ip.description:
The host with this IPv4 address, with all details instead of a page.
Combines only with `active`.

limit.description: Hosts to return, at most 200. Default 50.

mac.description:
The host with this MAC address, like `AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF`, with all
details instead of a page. Combines only with `active`.

search.description: Part of the name, IP or MAC, ignoring case.

name: fritz_interfaces
description: LAN interfaces and wireless networks with byte, packet and error counters; LAN ports.

name: fritz_internet
description: Internet connection: status, addresses, provider, DNS, rates, DSL line, and with `dsl_details` the error counters and line diagnosis of DSL.

dsl_details.description:
Also `dsl_details`: the DSL line with status, sync, standard,
profile, rates and maximum rates in kbit/s, noise margins and
attenuations in dB and power; the error counters (CRC, FEC, HEC,
errored seconds, resyncs) in total and since the sync where reported;
the line diagnosis with its state, the seconds since the line lost
its signal and the distance to a cable fault in meters; and hints.
Without details and with `note` on connections that are not DSL.

name: fritz_list_services
description: TR-064 services, or the actions of one service with their class. Only read actions can be called.

service.description: Like `DeviceInfo1` or `DeviceInfo:1`. Without it, all services.

name: fritz_log
description: Latest entries of the event log: connections, logins, WLAN, telephony. Filters by text, time and category. Personal data.

category.description:
Only entries of this category: `system`, `internet`, `telephony`,
`wlan` or `usb`. Reads the event log of the web interface; fails if
the device shows none with categories.

limit.description:
Entries to return after the filters, the latest first, at most 200.
Default 50.

search.description: Part of the message, ignoring case.

since.description:
Only entries since a duration ago, like `30m`, `24h`, `7d` or `2w`,
or since a date like `2026-11-20`.

name: fritz_mesh
description: Mesh topology: nodes with their IP addresses and the links between them, or as a tree of which device is connected to which router or repeater.

tree.description:
Nest every device below the router or repeater it is connected to,
with its links up.

name: fritz_overview
description: Model, firmware, uptime, update, internet connection, rights of the user, and with `system` CPU load, temperature and memory.

system.description:
Also `system`: CPU load in percent, CPU temperature in °C and memory
shares in percent, now and as min/avg/max over the history the device
keeps (24 hours). Experimental, read from the web interface; null with
`system_note` if the device does not show it.

name: fritz_phonebook
description: Contacts of the phonebooks with their numbers, by name or number. Personal data. Paginated.

limit.description: Contacts to return, at most 200. Default 50.

search.description: Part of the name, or digits of the number.

name: fritz_ports
description: Port forwardings and whether UPnP lets hosts open ports.

name: fritz_powerline
description: Powerline adapters: name, model, MAC, active, update available and the result of the last update. `supported` is false on devices without powerline support.

name: fritz_settings
description: Settings like DNS, IPv6, MTU, DHCP and time, by module, from the web interface. Secrets hidden.

modules.description:
Like `ipv6`. Without, the common modules: DNS, IPv6, internet, LAN
ports, mesh steering, routes, time. Others: `dect`, `filter_profile`, `inetstat`,
`landevice`, `mobiled`, `plc`, `tam`, `user`, `vpn`, `wlan`.

name: fritz_smarthome
description: Smart Home devices and their values (FRITZ!OS 8.20 and later).

device.description: The device, by name or AIN. Needs `history`.

history.description:
The history of `device` instead of the current values of all
devices: power (W) and voltage (V) over the last hours, energy (Wh)
per day and per month, temperature (°C) and humidity (%), each as a
series with its interval in seconds, the time of the newest value
(Unix seconds) and a summary (count, gaps, min, avg, max, and the
sum for energy).

values.description: Also all values of each series, the newest first, null for gaps.

name: fritz_telephony
description: Telephony: numbers, accounts, call deflections, answering machines, DECT handsets.

name: fritz_traffic
description: WAN traffic per direction: current and peak rate and line maximum in bit/s, utilization in percent, byte and packet totals; upstream by priority and multicast where reported. With `sample_seconds`, averages from the counters.

sample_seconds.description:
Read twice this many seconds apart, at most 10, and add `sample`
with the averages of the byte counters in between.

name: fritz_users
description: Users of the device (null if not allowed; names hidden without `--personal`), rights of the current user, login settings: anonymous and button login, default password, two-factor confirmation, and hints on weak settings. No passwords are read.

name: fritz_wlan
description: Wireless networks: SSID, band, channel, standard, status, guest network, number of clients, with `clients` the clients of each, and with `details` the security settings, radio, WPS, night time switch-off, statistics and hints on weak settings.

clients.description:
Also the clients of each network: name, IP, MAC, signal in percent
and rate in Mbit/s.

details.description:
Also the details of each network: security (beacon type, encryption,
hidden SSID, MAC filter, user isolation), radio (channel, automatic
channel, possible channels, BSSID), WPS, night time switch-off,
packet statistics, and hints on weak settings like `wps_enabled`,
`tkip_allowed` or `open_network`. Keys are never read.
